rationale: cli/output.py is the dominant, dependency-free, actively-tested convention with ~80 existing call sites in the exact 'dict -> status_block() -> print()' shape needed; rich/questionary is scoped only to the init wizard, has no timeout-capable .ask() precedent (a direct mismatch with this issue's shutdown-signal acceptance criterion), and its API surface for this use is unproven (learning_tests_required flag).
rule: Terminal adapter formatted-prompt rendering uses cli/output.py (colorize/status_block/table), not rich+questionary
